description: [Experimental web session] Check the AppMetrica web session (Chrome profile with a Yandex login) used by the web_* tools: logged_in, Yandex login, profile directory. Starts headless Chrome on first use (about 7 seconds). Uses the unofficial AppMetrica web API through a headless Chrome session: run `npx appmetrica-mcp login` once to log in to Yandex.
name: web_session_status
